amy_csm: FYI were seeing intermittent 5xx on EU onboarding + ingest between ~11:10-11:45 UTC impacting ~120 tenants. Drafting a short customer note + remediation offer, need fast review.

amy_csm: ```
Subject: Brief update  EU onboarding & ingest disruption

Hi there,

Earlier today (approx 11:1011:45 UTC) some EU onboarding and indexing/ingest requests returned errors for a subset of customers.

Short cause: a config propagation race in our auth-sync control plane led to token validation failures for certain onboarding paths.

Action taken: engineers deployed a targeted fix and a safety rollback; automated reprocessing ran and most writes were restored.

Impact & next steps: ~120 tenants saw failed or partial onboarding/index writes. We do not expect permanent data loss; remaining items will be replayed with affected customers. A full RCA will be published within 72 hours.

Support: affected customers will receive one month of account credit. Customers in active renewal discussions will be contacted by their AE for tailored remediation (extensions, credits, or technical replay). If you onboarded via SSO/VPC and still see failures, reply to this message or open a support ticket and well prioritize an engineering replay.

Status & updates: https://status.redwood.ai

Thanks  Amy, Customer Success
```

ben_support: +1. Suggest adding: "If you want immediate help, reply here and we'll open a priority ticket." Also include support portal link.

diego_eng: RCA note: control-plane retry storm + TTL race on config propagation produced expired token handoffs for ~3% of EU onboarding requests. Hotfix rolled at 11:32 UTC; safety rollback at 11:40 UTC. Automated backfills finished for ~98%; ~2% flagged for manual replay. Permanent fix ETA: 72h (PR + canary + tests).

priya_ae: For renewal accounts, please mark AE-managed so we can offer extensions instead of blanket credits. Ill follow up with my impacted renewals after the comm goes out.

amy_csm: Thanks all. Ill send at 14:00 UTC and post to the status page. Priya, please ping your renewals. ops-bot: Incident INC-20260322-1142 created (P2)
